info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Certificates API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of certificates associated with their education enrollments. This API is particularly useful for students, educational institutions, and administrative systems looking to manage and verify enrollment statuses and credentials. It provides access to vital information regarding each certificate, including its status and associated details. Typical consumers of this API include educational organizations and systems that require certificate validation and record keeping.

get.summary: Retrieve a certificate for a specific enrollment
get.description: Fetch the details of a certificate associated with a specific enrollment. This endpoint allows you to obtain the certificate information that can be essential for verifying the completion of a course or program.
